arithmetic_policy: All decisive statements below are exact rational or analytic. Float64 searches are scouts only.

analytic_falsifiers.target: For every unit-diagonal SPD A and x, E_pi D_pi(x) >= ||Ax||_2^2/16.
analytic_falsifiers.spd_certificate: The eigenvalues are 1/100 with multiplicity 16 and 421/25 on span{s}; hence A is unit-diagonal SPD with mu=1/100.
analytic_falsifiers.exact_ldlt_certificate: After diagonal sign conjugation, det(A[1:k,1:k])=delta^(k-1)(delta+k rho). The LDL pivots are 1 and delta(delta+k rho)/(delta+(k-1)rho) for k=2,...,17, all positive rational numbers.
analytic_falsifiers.without_replacement_calculation: For every permutation, the residual visited at position t is s_{pi_t}(1/100)^(t-1), so D_pi=sum_{t=0}^{16} 100^(-2t), independent of pi.
analytic_falsifiers.short_integer_certificate: D<10000/9999 and 16*10000 < 17*9999 because the integer gap is 9983.
analytic_falsifiers.dimension_minimality: For every A, E D>=||Ax||^2/n. Therefore the locked 1/16 inequality is automatically true for n<=16, so n=17 is the smallest possible counterexample dimension.
analytic_falsifiers.reason: This refutes only the locked stronger residual comparison, not C050. On this witness D/(mu*x^T A x) is large, so there is no RPCD counterexample.

analytic_falsifiers.target: Any universal repair E D >= c ||Ax||_2^2 based on the same scalar comparison with c independent of n.
analytic_falsifiers.family: The signed equicorrelation family above with arbitrary n and rho tending to 1 from below.
analytic_falsifiers.matching_lower_bound: For every A and residual r=Ax, D_pi is at least the first visited residual squared. A uniform first coordinate therefore gives E D_pi >= ||r||_2^2/n.
analytic_falsifiers.conclusion: The optimal universal coefficient for a pure initial-Euclidean-residual comparison has infimum exactly 1/n.

analytic_falsifiers.target: A scalar random-transposition variance proxy can recover initial residual energy with no dimension factor.
analytic_falsifiers.identity: For pi' obtained by swapping a uniformly random unordered pair of positions, (1/2)E(h(pi)-h(pi'))^2=[2/(n(n-1))]||r-r_bar*1||_2^2, while Var(h)=||r-r_bar*1||_2^2/n.
analytic_falsifiers.consequence: Dirichlet/Var=2/(n-1), so inversion costs the sharp factor (n-1)/2.
analytic_falsifiers.exact_enumeration_control: At n=5 and r=(-3,-1,0,1,3), Var(h)=4 and E(h-h')^2=4, hence Dirichlet/Var=1/2=2/(n-1).

analytic_falsifiers.target: The unamplified endpoint discrepancy of a random transposition is itself a mu-scale contraction certificate.
analytic_falsifiers.family: Positive equicorrelation A=delta I+(1-delta)11^T with residual r=1.
analytic_falsifiers.identity: Swapping positions i<j changes the terminal iterate by (delta^(j-1)-delta^(i-1))(e_a-e_b), whose squared A-norm is 2 delta (delta^(i-1)-delta^(j-1))^2.
analytic_falsifiers.asymptotic: Averaging all unordered pairs gives 4 delta/n+o(delta), whereas delta times the initial A-energy is delta+o(delta). The raw proxy therefore loses a factor n.
analytic_falsifiers.qualification: The sharp permutation Poincare multiplier is order n and could compensate this loss exactly once; this falsifier does not refute the compensated proxy.

analytic_falsifiers.target: Scalar exchangeable-pair variance of D alone lower-bounds dissipation.
analytic_falsifiers.calculation: All coordinate projections commute, every epoch ends at zero, and D_pi=||x||_2^2 for every pi, but D_pi-D_pi'=0 for every transposition.
analytic_falsifiers.conclusion: A baseline dissipation term and vector trajectory information are indispensable.

analytic_falsifiers.target: Test whether the F1 obstruction persists merely because of full permutation symmetry.
analytic_falsifiers.outcome: no obstruction on this exact slice
analytic_falsifiers.family: A has one hub, 16 independent leaves, and hub-leaf entries 99/400. Its eigenvalues are 1/100, 1 with multiplicity 15, and 199/100.
analytic_falsifiers.low_eigen_direction: For residual (-4,1,...,1), exact average dissipation is 7029127201/80000000 and D/(mu energy)=7029127201/2560000000, so the near-singular target direction also gives no hit.
analytic_falsifiers.analytic_limit: For m square leaves, q tending to 1, and then m tending to infinity, D/||r||^2 tends to 11/24, not 0.
analytic_falsifiers.interpretation: Null result only; it shows the 1/n failure is not reproduced by this hub-leaf asymmetry.

analytic_falsifiers.target: Stress block, signed, and partial-commutation behavior.
analytic_falsifiers.outcome: no obstruction on this exact finite slice
analytic_falsifiers.family: Direct sum of 2x2 correlation blocks with q=9/10,-4/5,2/3 and residual (1,1,1,-1,2,-1).
analytic_falsifiers.interpretation: Null result only. Inter-block updates commute and within-block updates do not.

adjacent_transposition_identity.statement: For a common prefix state z with r=Az, adjacent coordinates a,b, alpha=r_a, beta=r_b, and q=A_ab, let z_ab=U_b U_a z and z_ba=U_a U_b z. Then z_ab-z_ba=q(alpha e_b-beta e_a), and the two-step dissipation difference is q^2(alpha^2-beta^2).

compensated_proxy_finite_controls.candidate: B_A(x)=||E_pi T_pi x||_A^2+(n-1)E_{pi,pair}||T_pi x-T_pi' x||_A^2/4 <= (1-c mu)||x||_A^2.
compensated_proxy_finite_controls.poincare_transfer: The random-transposition Poincare inequality gives E||T_pi x||_A^2 <= B_A(x).
exact_slices: unequal signed 2x2 blocks n=6 (720 permutations, 10800 pair cases)
interacting signed Hadamard n=4 with parameters 1/2,1/4,-1/10 and mu=3/20
compensated_proxy_finite_controls.check: For each slice, every principal minor of B-E[T^TAT] and every principal minor of (1-mu)A-B is nonnegative in exact rational arithmetic.
compensated_proxy_finite_controls.status: finite_verified only; not a general statement
compensated_proxy_finite_controls.high_mode_control: The alternating endpoint matrix is nonzero on the rational noncommuting n=3 adjacent-swap test, with exact Frobenius norm squared 1236793/116640000, but is exactly zero on the unequal signed two-block n=4 control. This selects the sign mode as a future falsifier and proves no general bound.

permutation_martingale_obstruction_contr.family: The n=17, delta=1/100 signed-equicorrelation high-eigen residual used in F1.
permutation_martingale_obstruction_contr.state: M_t=E[T_pi x | pi_1,...,pi_t]; in sign coordinates, exposed labels receive powers delta^(t-1) and unexposed labels receive their remaining average.
permutation_martingale_obstruction_contr.innovation_energy: At step t with m=n-t+1 remaining labels, delta*m*(delta^(t-1)-a_(t-1))^2/(m-1).
permutation_martingale_obstruction_contr.exact_check: The sum of all innovations equals the centered endpoint variance, and the sharp global transposition Dirichlet term equals the same variance.
permutation_martingale_obstruction_contr.interpretation: Both without-replacement decompositions are lossless on the locked obstruction because it lies in the standard permutation representation. The general conditional-future difference still contains the nonadjacent interval product, so this is an exact structured control rather than a universal proof.

alternating_mode_structure_and_failed_st.exact_cancellation: In the alternant expansion, terms omitting at least two update factors cancel by swapping omitted labels. Terms omitting exactly one factor also cancel for even n; for odd n their insertion-sign sum has magnitude one.
alternating_mode_structure_and_failed_st.weak_coupling_order: For A=I+epsilon H with diag(H)=0, Alt_A is O(epsilon^(n-2)) for odd n and O(epsilon^(n-1)) for even n.
alternating_mode_structure_and_failed_st.symbolic_n3_formula: With u=A12,v=A13,w=A23, 6 Alt_A has rows [v^2-u^2,u(w^2-1),v(1-w^2)]; [u(1-v^2),u^2-w^2,w(v^2-1)]; [v(u^2-1),w(1-u^2),w^2-v^2], and determinant zero.
alternating_mode_structure_and_failed_st.actual_proxy_separation: For the same rational matrix, det(A-I/550)<0 and trace(A)=3 imply mu<1/550; every principal minor of (1-1/550)A-B is nonnegative. Thus B<=(1-1/550)A<=(1-mu)A exactly.
alternating_mode_structure_and_failed_st.interpretation: Exact refutation of this stronger route-local repair only. The same matrix exactly passes the actual compensated EP inequality at c=1, and it does not refute C050.

multiepoch_finite_control.candidate: The tensorized two-epoch mean-plus-Dirichlet proxy has a c_0=1 mu-gap.
multiepoch_finite_control.family: n=3 positive equicorrelation with rho=9/10 and mu=1/10
multiepoch_finite_control.exact_check: Every principal minor of the product-space Poincare slack and of (1-mu)A-B_A^(2) is nonnegative.
multiepoch_finite_control.second_family: Interacting signed Hadamard n=4 with offdiagonal parameters 1/2,1/4,-1/10, eigenvalues 3/20,17/20,27/20,33/20, 576 permutation sequences, and 3456 transposition cases per slot also passes at c_0=1.
multiepoch_finite_control.metric_map_recursion: With H(Q)=E T^TQT, G(Q)=(n-1)E(T-T')^TQ(T-T')/4, and M=E T, the exact identity B_A^(m)=(M^m)^T A M^m+sum_{ell=1}^m H^(ell-1)G(H^(m-ell)(A)) avoids (n!)^m enumeration.
multiepoch_finite_control.recursive_exact_controls: The interacting signed Hadamard n=4 family passes all-principal-minor checks at c_0=1 for m=1,2,3,4. Its exact minimum generalized gaps divided by mu are approximately 2.4050277832, 4.0774377001, 5.1031265040, and 5.7231693545. This is E2 finite evidence only.
multiepoch_finite_control.status: E2 finite verification only; no general or all-dimensional conclusion

numerical_scout.tolerance: No pass/fail tolerance was used; values were scouts and no null result was promoted.
numerical_scout.outcome: No random sample beat the analytic signed-equicorrelation obstruction. This is E1 only.

extended_numerical_scout.tolerance: No theorem/pass tolerance; the deterministic Hadamard grid used only an SPD eigenvalue filter of 1e-12.
extended_numerical_scout.hadamard_grid: 85 SPD cases on {-0.6,-0.3,0,0.3,0.6}^3; minimum one-epoch and two-epoch proxy gaps divided by mu were both 1 at A=I.
extended_numerical_scout.outcome: No hit. This is an E1 null search and is not a proof of the proxy.
